description: Code's write-up from the day's stored values: the comparison opens, else the served call's rain character; the sky and wind from the anchors with the served gust; UV and the worst station, else the CAMS figure; the trend clause and the served leads with the inputs' highs; the boaters' section with its storm sentence where thunder is possible; a sign-off that promises a discussion only where a model is configured. Every sentence passes phrase_defect or is dropped.

cases.name: a stored day with every field

input.overview_comparison: Slightly warmer than yesterday; winds and cloud little changed. Dry by day, with thunder possible, peaking this evening again.
input.extended_trend: Warming through Saturday, with showers returning by Monday

cases.expected:
## Today's Forecast

Slightly warmer than yesterday; winds and cloud little changed. Dry by day, with thunder possible, peaking this evening again. 32°C / 90°F high, 19°C / 66°F low. Sky mostly cloudy early, partly cloudy at midday and mostly cloudy in the evening. Wind NNE early, SSW at midday and WSW in the evening; gusts to 33 km/h (18 kt). UV index 9.2 (very high). Air quality 103 (unhealthy for sensitive groups) at Kisumu Airport, the highest of 3 stations.

## Extended Outlook

Warming through Saturday, with showers returning by Monday. Saturday (Day+3): dry, 28% chance of rain; highs 31 to 34 °C. Wednesday (Day+7): rain likely, 82% chance; highs 29 to 35 °C.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters

Peak gust 30 km/h (16 kt). Any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above this figure; the water is unsafe while one is nearby.
